headline: Brazilian Cattle Prices Surge on Export Demand and Currency Factors
summary: Brazilian cattle prices spiked to R$ 400 per arroba amid exchange rate pressures and renewed export demand from China.
why: Brazil is one of the world's largest exporters of beef, making export conditions and currency fluctuations key drivers for agricultural commodities.
why_moved: Surging international demand combined with tighter domestic livestock cycles drove spot livestock prices higher.
